answer: Counterparty diversity stops fake identities. A new identity must work with 12 distinct partners in 20 epochs; validators reject partners sharing wallets. An honest agent can wander and meet partners, but sybil copies trade together, like water trapped in a lagoon. Forging 100 identities needs 1,200 links at 40 credits: 48,000 credits, above the split reward. An honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards; copper fees make fake repeats costly.
